The two independent commits really occur: getTrelloTokenForUser conditionally rewrites integrations.accessToken before importRepo.create inserts the imports row. The rewrite preserves the decoded credential, uses the versioned encryption prefix and a compare-and-set update, and is intentionally independent of whether the import starts. Its partial state is harmless, so this is intended-risk under the hazard-precision taxonomy, not a nonexistent write/window. Keep the diagnostic; it is not a confirmed bug. Upgrade/downgrade writes each kept subscription at webhook.ts:287 and each linked workspace at :299 in Promise.all on the root DB, without one transaction. For an existing linked slot, one UPDATE can commit and the other fail, leaving subscription entitlements and workspace plan inconsistent. Promise.all does not roll back completed siblings. HTTP 500 handling in withApiLogging is not durable compensation or a guaranteed redelivery contract. This is the already reported inner-handler window at 574be59f041f0e7e, exposed at the default export, not a new independent bug.

findings.notes: The first insertion is reached only through createAndLinkSlots when newCount > existing.length (webhook.ts:303-314). The later removed-subscription UPDATE requires slotsToRemove.length > 0 (:317-329). preferKeep is the concatenation of the truthy and falsy referenceId partitions of existing (:277-280), so its length equals existing.length.
